g.text: Dots: paired within-family differences. Diamonds: equal-family type means. Lines: observed family min–max.
Ranges are observed family min–max, NOT confidence intervals; a zero-width range collapses to its mean marker.
Failure-inclusive planned denominator. An interaction of zero or a ceiling does not establish equivalence or mechanism isolation.
